tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lo dril gnyis kyi smon lam shis brjod bzhugs so/ /

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lo dril gnyis kyi smon lam shis brjod gsar pa bya bar 'dod pas/ dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud kyi don/ /grub chen lo dril zhabs kyi man ngag las/ /dbang po mchog gi nyams len rim pa gnyis// ches zab rtogs nas goms te mngon 'gyur shog /bsag sbyang mthar son sdud rim zab mo yis/ /'chi srid chos skur bsgyur byed rnal 'byor dang*/ /nā das rten gyi steng du dkar dmar gyi/ /zla bar bzhugs pa'i rjes su rnal 'byor gyis| |bar srid longs sku'i lam du legs par bsgyur/ /dkar dmar me long mnyam nyid mngon 'gyur shog /nā da rim gyis 'phel ba'i hūm̐ yig ni/ /sor rtog ye shes rgyu yi rdo rje 'dzin/ /'od 'phros don byas 'dus pa bde chen 'bar// 'phrin las bya grub ye shes rdzogs par shog /de dang zla ba dkar dmar dbyangs gsal kun/ /yongs gyur rten dang brten pa go char bcas/ /cig char rdzogs pa'i chos dbyings ye shes ste/ /de la ye shes dgug gzhug dbang bskur mchod| |gsal brtan rnam dag shin tu rnal 'byor gyis/ /skye srid sprul sku'i lam kun rdzogs par shog /dbyangs gsal spros 'dus lte bar ri bong can// lhan skyes bde chen 'bar ba'i ye shes sku/ /snyoms 'jug sgras bskul rjes gzhig bsdud rim ches/ /rnal 'byor chen pos rdzogs rim smin byed shog/ bdag byin rlabs dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ /nor bu 'gengs dang dzā lan dha ra dang*| |bsam mi khyab ste zab lam rim pa lnga/ /dang po gnyis la sa bon yod med bzhi/ /gsum par phyag rgya bzhir dbyer dmigs rim bcu/ bcu po'i dang po rtsa yi rnal 'byor ste/ /rtsa ba'i thig le yan lag dbang po lnga/ / gnyis pa rdo rje'i bzlas pa'ang de bzhin drug /gsum pa bum pa can yang de bzhin te/ /rtsa 'khor bzhir bcas kha sbyor rnam pa dgu/ /bzhi pa mdzod spu'i kha sbyor rgyan can te|

|gsang dbang lam mchog rtsa rlung mthar phyin shog /de mthus byang sems 'pho med gyur pa na/ /phyi nang las rgya gnyis dang ye shes dang*/ /stong gzugs rgya phyag chen mos legs par spel/ /gtum mo 'bar bas gsum pa'i lam rdzogs shog /bde chen mtha' dag spros bral rnam ldan dang*/ /des bskyed rang byung bcom ldan mngon 'gyur te/ /spangs rtogs yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pas| |zung 'jug bzhi pa'i lam kun mthar phyin shog /ces smon lam du bya te| lo hi pa'i rnal 'byor chen po yang 'di nang legs par 'dus pas lo dril gnyis ka'i smon lam 'di nyid kyis 'grub mod/ 'on kyang lo hi pa la dgos su sbyor na/ mthar phyin shog gi rjes su/ sprul par sems brtan nyi zla'i 'gros bcom nas/ /yas babs mas brtan dga' bzhi yongs rdzogs shing*/ /rdo rje'i bzlas pas mchog gi dbang phyug ma/ /mnyes te dpe yi 'od gsal 'char bar shog |'ja' lus snyoms 'jug sgras bskul rjes gzhig dang*/ /mnyam rjes bde stong mchog gis bzung 'dzin sbyangs/ /sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs yang yang 'od gsal zhugs/ /slob dang mi slob zung 'jug mngon gyur shog /de ltar rnal 'byor chen po'i rdzogs rim la/ /'gal rkyen kun spangs mthun rkyen mkha' 'gros bsgrubs/ /'chi tshe ngo mtshar ltas ky-is phyogs kun khyab/ /mkha' spyod gnas deng 'dir stsol/ /de nyid kyi sku'i rnam 'phrul thar pa chen su lam kun mthar phyin shog /ces sbyar/ / shis brjod ni/ rab 'byams skye dgu'i dge legs ma lus pa/ /gcig bsdus 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs rnams/ /mkha' dngos 'gengs pa'i rnam rol mtha' yas kyis/ /shis brjod dge legs stsaul ba 'di ltar ro/ /dge legs thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ /dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ /yon tan thams cad kyi gter mdzod/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i rnam 'phrul/ / chos sku zag med bde stong gi ye shes/

/byang phyogs so bdun longs sku sgrib bral gyi rtsa dang thig le lus kyi dkyil 'khor/ sprul sku gang la gang 'dul gyi 'byung lus phra rags gnas gsum mkha' 'gro thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po dang*/ de nyid dbang bzhi pa'i lam gyi sgrub tshul gtso bor gsal bar mdzad pa/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa dang*/ dbang gsum pa'i lam gyi sgrub tshul gtso bor gsal ba mdzad pa dbang phyug lo hi pa la sogs pa dang*/ dbang gnyis pa'i lam gyi sgrub tshul gtso bor gsal bar mdzad pa grub chen nag po spyod pa la sogs pa bla ma dam pa bar ma chad par byon pa rnams kyi bkra shis dang dge legs kyi 'byor pas khyed cag skye dgu thams cad nyin mtshan du skyong par gyur cig sku gsum dbyer med rdo rje 'chang dbang dngos/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i rnam 'phrul sna tshogs kyis/ /sa gsum 'gro la bde mchog dga' ston 'gyed/ /dus gsum bla ma'i bkra shis po'i khang bzang na bde ba chen po'i dpal 'byor zad mi shes pa la rtag tu rol zhing*| gang la gang 'tshams pa'i 'phrin las kyis skye dgu lhag par skyong ba lha drug cu rtsa gnyis la sogs pa dpal 'khor lo sdom pa sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi rnam pa bzhugs pa rnams kyis/ gang sku khro chags gar kyi nyams kun gyis// tshar gcad rjes bzung 'phrin las bsam mi khyab/ /he ru ka dpal dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i tshogs/ /sangs rgyas dkon mchog bkra shis deng 'dir stsol| |de nyid kyi gsung gi rnam 'phrul dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud mngon brjod 'bum pa/ bsdus pa'i rgyud bde mchog nyung ngu/ khyab byed kyi rgyud nam mkha' dang mnyam pa/ thun mong gi bshad rgyud kun tu kha sbyor/ thun mong ma yin pa'i mngon rtogs kyi bshad rgyud mngon brjod bla ma/ cho ga'i bshad rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ khyad par gyi bshad rgyud 'byung ba gsum dang kun tu spyod pa/

cha mthun gyi bshad rgyud mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la sogs pa ma rgyud bye ba phrag bcu drug gi brjod bya dang rjod byed thams cad kyi/ gang gsung ches zab rtogs dka' rdo rje'i tshig /'khor lo sdom pa'i brjod bya rjod byed tshogs/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed rnam dkar lung rtogs dngos/ /dam chos dkon mchog bkra shis deng 'dir stsol/ /de nyid kyi thugs kyi rnam 'phrul gnas las skyes pa/ zhing las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa'i pho nya dang pho nya mo'i mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa dang rnal 'byor ma mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa la brtson pa/ 'phrin las bzhi dang grub chen brgyad dang*/ phyi nang gi sa bcu'i spangs rtogs la gnas pa dge 'dun dkon mchog du bzhugs pa thams cad kyi/ gang gsung brtse ba'i byin rlabs nyin mtshan du/ /legs par zhugs pas lam 'dir rab brtson zhing*| |mchog dang thun mong dngos grub legs par thob/ /dge 'dun dkon mchog bkra shis deng 'dir stsol/ /mdor na dpal ldan sdom pa'i lha tshogs kyis| |mngon par mtho zhing srid zhi'i dgra 'joms pa/ /ji snyed mchis pa'i bkra shis dge legs kun/ /nyin mtshan kun tu rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog/ces shis brjod rgyas par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di yang dge slong lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyis sbyar ba'o// // maṅga laṃ// bhawantu// shubhaṃ// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tswa ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lo dril gnyis kyi smon lam shis brjod/ -PAGE 284--PAGE 283--PAGE 280-
